pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Discrete polygonal regions with low-frequency edge definition and smoothed pixel gradients. Relative spatial area is moderate, showing higher fragmentation and reduced size in the upper cervical region.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Light-toned inter-patch spacing forming a continuous network of tri-radial and quadri-radial junction nodes. Pixel thickness is variable but remains continuous across the visible flank and neck segments.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Jagged 1D contour along the dorsal neck with low-amplitude vertical oscillations. Silhouette edges are soft due to motion or focus blur.
